title: Bridge
description: Built an AI assessment generator with LangChain, rule-based checks, and LLM quality review to reduce invalid outputs and improve consistency. Implemented agentic interviews by indexing code submissions in Pinecone and integrating the ElevenLabs Agent API. June–September 2026.

title: EMG Piano Decoder
description: As a Triton Neurotech team member, engineered a real-time system that translates four-channel forearm EMG signals into piano key presses across one octave. Used MediaPipe Hands for ground-truth labels and fine-tuned a Vision Transformer pretrained on emg2pose to detect individual notes and chords. January–March 2026.

title: TritonPlanner
description: Scraped and cleaned more than 7,000 UCSD course listings using Selenium and organized them in Pinecone vector databases. Built a RAG course assistant with OpenAI and Pinecone, and helped develop a React planner with a drag-and-drop four-year schedule, course search, and graduation requirements. January–April 2025.
